title: Project on Tourism and Travel Management

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Practicing steps in designing a full package tourism program (from researching demand, supply, building framework, detailed program, pricing to completing the program)
Practicing overall process of operating a tourism program: planning, negotiating with suppliers, working with guides, coordinating with local partners, evaluating results
Practicing guiding steps (preparation before trip, welcoming, sending off, handling unexpected situations)
Practicing negotiation skills and communication skills when working with suppliers and during the trip
Practicing writing a specialized project report
Demonstrating high sense of responsibility for assigned tasks, actively participating in activities before, during, and after the trip
Actively seeking information about the profession, setting specific directions for career development, and cultivating a love for the profession
Respecting and protecting tourism resources and having a positive attitude towards sustainable tourism development
Respecting local culture and developing a multicultural perspective in tourism
